### 文件柜修复与代码简化 / File cabinet fixes and simplification

- **修复文件柜异步请求竞态。** 连续切换目录、刷新或切换联系人后，迟到的浏览与分页结果不会覆盖当前目录、混入旧条目或错误清除加载状态；切走再切回同一联系人也能正确识别旧请求。拖入文件等待授权时切换联系人后，不再继续发起已过期的上传。
- 聊天侧栏与文件柜页签共用浏览、选择和传输逻辑，各自保留独立状态；切换目录不影响正在发起的上传。授权候选筛选改用集合查询，清理重复判断、不可达分支和无用导出，补齐业务注释。
- 合并重复测试夹具与等待逻辑、辅助传输登记及 UTF-8 截断函数，统一多客户端启动脚本；新增竞态行为回归测试，减少绑定源码写法的断言。未增加依赖，Electron 22.3.27 与现有运行时兼容基线保持不变。
- **Fix file cabinet request races.** Late browse and pagination results no longer overwrite the current directory, append stale entries, or clear the current loading state after navigation, refresh, or peer changes. Returning to the same peer also invalidates earlier requests. Dropped files awaiting authorization no longer start an obsolete upload after switching peers.
- The chat sidebar and cabinet tab share browsing, selection, and transfer logic while retaining independent state. Directory navigation preserves uploads being initiated. Grant candidate filtering uses set lookups; redundant checks, unreachable branches, and unused exports were removed, and business rules were documented.
- Deduplicated test fixtures and polling, auxiliary transfer registration, and UTF-8 truncation; unified multi-client launch scripts. Added behavior regressions for races and reduced assertions tied to source formatting. No dependencies were added; Electron 22.3.27 and existing runtime compatibility baselines are unchanged.

### 验证与范围 / Validation and scope

- 基于最新 v0.61.7 整合，保留拖窗修复、长文件名预览及会话收起与草稿功能。Linux 本地 137 个测试文件、1004 项测试通过；Electron ABI 数据库自测、双端类型检查、生产构建、Xvfb 启动冒烟、版本一致性及双语文档检查通过。
- 本轮未额外进行 Windows/macOS 真机及真实多机局域网验收；各平台构建与产物版本校验由既有发布工作流执行。
- Integrated on v0.61.7, retaining window-drag fixes, long-file-name previews, and conversation hiding with draft preservation. Local Linux validation passed: 1004 tests across 137 files, the Electron ABI database self-test, both type checks, production build, Xvfb startup smoke, version consistency, and documentation locale checks.
- No additional Windows/macOS hardware or real multi-machine LAN acceptance was performed in this round. The existing release workflow builds each platform and validates artifact versions.
